Website Development

This repository also powers www.shreejitverma.com (Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS v4, deployed on Vercel).

npm run dev          # local dev server
npm run build        # production build
npm run lint         # ESLint
npm run typecheck    # TypeScript strict check
npm run test:e2e     # full Playwright E2E suite (desktop + mobile)

The E2E suite (e2e/) covers every public page; e2e/README.md lists what each spec checks. CI runs lint, typecheck, and the full suite on every pull request (.github/workflows/e2e.yml). scripts/enrich_books.py enriches the reading-list dataset with cover images and descriptions from Open Library and Google Books; it is resumable and idempotent. scripts/import_vault_covers.py imports curated covers from the Obsidian vault (Reading/Library/ notes and Attachments/Covers/) as 320px WebP files under public/covers/, matching books by title and author and never guessing: ambiguous matches, generated title-card covers, and titles listed in scripts/cover_overrides.json are skipped. Adding a title to that skip list also clears a vault cover it already received, so enrich_books.py fetches a hotlinked one on its next run. Vault covers take precedence over the hotlinked covers from enrich_books.py, which never overwrites an existing cover; rerun the import after adding books or covers to the vault (python3 scripts/import_vault_covers.py --dry-run previews the changes). scripts/make_icons.py renders the "SV" monogram site icons (app/favicon.ico, app/icon.png, app/apple-icon.png); rerun it with uv run --with pillow python3 scripts/make_icons.py after changing the theme's primary color. .github/workflows/metrics.yml refreshes the GitHub Impact cards daily and publishes them to the output branch: scripts/github_stats.py writes github-stats.json (rendered natively on the home page), scripts/github_cards.py draws the README's stats and language cards from it, and python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests tests both. scripts/categorize_books.py assigns book categories through hand-curated overrides (scripts/category_overrides.json), title-family regex rules, and ordered keyword rules, keeping the General shelf a small miscellany bucket. scripts/ also holds standalone personal data tooling unrelated to the site, such as scripts/amazon_ir_scraper.py, which downloads Amazon investor-relations PDFs (annual reports, proxy statements, shareholder letters) into ~/Downloads/Amazon_IR_Documents. backlog.md is the workspace task backlog managed by tasks-axi.

Agent access

The site is built to be read and used by AI agents, and scores Level 5 ("Agent-Native") on Cloudflare's Agent Readiness scanner. Everything is public, read-only, and unauthenticated, and every surface answers from the same data as the pages (app/lib/profile.ts, app/lib/open-source.ts, app/lib/writing.ts, app/lib/agent/pages.ts). The code lives in app/lib/agent/; e2e/agent-ready.spec.ts covers each endpoint.

Surface Where Notes
Markdown for agents any page with Accept: text/markdown, or /index.md, /resume.md, ... Converted from the page's own rendered <main>, so it never drifts from the HTML; sends x-markdown-tokens and Content-Signal
llms.txt, llms-full.txt /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt Generated from the profile, open-source knowledge bases, and page list
Crawler policy /robots.txt Content Signals search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=yes plus explicit AI search, user-triggered, and training crawler groups (CONTENT_SIGNAL in app/lib/agent/constants.ts)
MCP server /mcp (streamable HTTP, stateless) Ten read-only tools: profile, experience, projects, open-source knowledge bases, education, skills, search, JSON Resume, page list, page as Markdown; Server Card at /mcp/server-card
A2A agent /a2a (JSON-RPC, protocol 1.0 and 0.3) Deterministic retrieval, no LLM; Agent Card at /.well-known/agent-card.json
WebMCP inline <head> script Registers five in-browser tools before load
REST /resume.json (JSON Resume), /api/search?q= Described by /openapi.json
Discovery /.well-known/api-catalog (RFC 9727), /.well-known/ai-catalog.json, /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json, /.well-known/did.json, /.well-known/poppy.json, Link response headers Catalogs point at each other and at every endpoint above

Markdown is fetched from this same deployment and converted per request (app/lib/agent/markdown.ts), so a Markdown response is marked private: the same URL serves HTML to browsers. If the Cloudflare proxy is enabled, the Vercel function's self-fetch of the canonical origin must be exempted from bot protection (for example with a WAF skip rule), otherwise the Markdown endpoints return 502. Adding a page to SITE_PAGES in app/lib/agent/pages.ts adds it to the sitemap, llms.txt, the Markdown rewrites, and the agent tools at once.

Agent authentication

A recruiter's AI agent can send Shreejit a job opportunity, but only after a person approves it; everything else stays public. The code is in app/lib/auth/, app/lib/opportunities.ts, and app/lib/agent/web-bot-auth.ts; e2e/agent-auth.spec.ts drives every flow end to end.

Piece Where Standard
Authorization server metadata /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server RFC 8414, plus the auth.md agent_auth block
Protected resource metadata /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource[/mcp/recruiter, /api/opportunities] RFC 9728
Client registration, authorize, token, revoke, JWKS /oauth/register, /oauth/authorize, /oauth/token, /oauth/revoke, /oauth/jwks.json RFC 7591, OAuth 2.1 with mandatory S256 PKCE (RFC 7636), RFC 9207, RFC 7009, RFC 7517
Agentic registration and claim /agent/identity, /agent/identity/claim, /claim, /auth.md auth.md (anonymous identity only)
Protected endpoints POST /api/opportunities, MCP at /mcp/recruiter (send_opportunity, whoami) Bearer tokens (RFC 6750), audience-bound (RFC 8707)
Web Bot Auth /.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory; the Markdown fetcher signs its requests RFC 9421, Ed25519

Access tokens are EdDSA JWTs (RFC 9068) that last 15 minutes; codes and refresh tokens are single use, enforced by an atomic read-and-delete. Claiming an auth.md registration or revoking a grant takes effect immediately, because the resource server checks the grant behind every token. Each submission becomes an issue in the private repo shreejitverma/opportunities, with all submitted text fenced so it cannot inject Markdown or mentions; each approval may send 3 per day, and all agents together 30.

Configuration (Vercel, all environments). On Vercel a missing or unusable key fails closed: auth endpoints answer 503, while the Markdown fetcher logs signing failures and sends unsigned requests. PKCS#8 values are normalized when pasted from environment variable UIs, including quoted values, escaped or flattened newlines, and a shell prompt line; values without usable key material return 503. Off Vercel the keys are generated per process and state lives in memory, so local runs and the e2e suite need nothing.

Variable Value
AUTH_SIGNING_KEY Ed25519 private key, PKCS#8 PEM (openssl genpkey -algorithm ed25519); signs tokens
WEB_BOT_AUTH_KEY A second, separate Ed25519 key in the same format; signs outbound bot requests, with unsigned fallback on signing failure
REDIS_URL, or KV_REST_API_URL and KV_REST_API_TOKEN Redis from the Vercel Marketplace, set automatically when connected: REDIS_URL (TCP, e.g. the Redis integration) or Upstash's REST pair
GITHUB_OPPORTUNITIES_TOKEN Fine-grained token with Issues read and write on shreejitverma/opportunities only

To rotate a key, replace the variable and redeploy: outstanding access tokens and identity assertions stop verifying, and agents re-authenticate. Because state is in memory locally, npm run test:e2e needs a fresh server; reusing one across many runs eventually hits the 30-per-day submission cap by design.

Search visibility

  • Structured data (app/lib/structured-data.ts) is derived from app/lib/profile.ts and app/lib/open-source.ts, so search engines and AI assistants see the same employer, titles, and degrees as readers; ProfilePage is declared only on / and /resume.
  • .github/workflows/indexnow.yml submits every sitemap URL to IndexNow (Bing, which also backs ChatGPT search and Copilot, plus Yandex, Seznam, Naver, and Yep) after each successful production deployment; python3 scripts/indexnow.py --dry-run previews the payload.
  • The sitemap sets lastmod only from real dates (article publication), never the build time, so search engines can trust it.
  • Agent and discovery endpoints send a strong ETag and answer a matching If-None-Match with 304 Not Modified, so revalidating crawlers transfer nothing.
  • /feed.xml is an Atom feed of the articles, linked from every page and from llms.txt.
  • URLs from earlier versions of the site, including old resume PDF paths, permanently redirect to their current pages (LEGACY_REDIRECTS in next.config.ts), so their ranking signals carry over instead of ending in a 404.
